legend: This example demonstrates increased intraglandular architectural complexity with papillary epithelial infoldings. The columnar epithelium shows abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm with enlarged mildly atypical nuclei and contrasts with that lining a Nabothian cyst at the bottom left.

The involved glands (left half of image) show columnar cells with abundant pale cytoplasmic mucin and scattered cytoplasmic granules resembling Paneth cells. Nuclei are basally oriented with limited stratification and show enlarged nuclei and prominent nucleoli.
This gland shows partial involvement by tall columnar cells exhibiting pale to clear cytoplasm, some nuclear stratification, and moderate cytological atypia.

diagnosis: Atypical lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia, low power
legend: In a focus of lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia (right half of image), two glands (far left) exhibit subtle atypical features with epithelial infolding, mild nuclear stratification, enlargement, and atypia.
This cervical loop excision shows gastric-type adenocarcinoma in situ demonstrating increased intraglandular architectural complexity, abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and subtle nuclear atypia.
